_comment: intake island toolchain (homelab#3577): what a sitting reads with and can run a repo gate with — jq, gh, kubectl, s5cmd, python3, uv, promtool (package prometheus), yq (package yq-go). The sitting's pod is the worker base image (agent-base), which already carries claude, git and curl; the bootstrap in agents/coordinator/island-intake-argo.yaml runs the launcher through `devbox run` in THIS directory. Versions: the repo-root devbox.lock's entries, copied (s5cmd and uv, which the root does not carry, are agent-base's own lock entries — already in the image's /nix store). The repo-root devbox.json/devbox.lock are never touched.
